name: trellis-cleanup-loop-with-cli-smoke-harness
description: For behavior-preserving cleanup of CLI commands whose output paths have thin test coverage: (1) trellis audit --json --out before.json as baseline; (2) git worktree add <scratch>/base HEAD + symlink node_modules so the pre-change CLI stays runnable; (3) write a smoke script that seeds a temp project and runs each affected command in text, --json, --quiet, --dry-run and error variants, run it against base/src/cli.ts and src/cli.ts, diff -r the outputs (only recorded_at timestamps and absolute paths should differ); (4) lint + typecheck + targeted bun test after each change, trellis compare per step. Consolidations that paid off in mulch: reportCommandError(cmd, jsonMode, err) replaced ~75 copies of the json/text/exitCode error block; runBulkRecord for --batch/--stdin; walkDomainLines/walkDomainRecords in doctor; applyQueryFilters; updateRecordById in api.ts. Leave per-format prose templates, the static reference schema, and cli.ts import/register lists alone - trellis flags them as clones but they are clearer as-is.
